components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; background: #5b9df5; color: #04101f; border: 1px solid #5b9df5; border-radius: 0.6rem; padding: 0.62rem 1rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.12s ease, transform 0.08s ease; } .ds-btn-primary .ds-icon { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7db0f7; border-color: #7db0f7; filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b9df5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: Four states, each a distinct drawn shape as well as color — never color alone.
components.css: .ds-dot { --size: 0.7rem; width: var(--size); height: var(--size); border-radius: 50%; position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-block; } .ds-dot-streaming { background: #34d399; } .ds-dot-idle { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid #8b95a5; } .ds-dot-connecting { background: transparent; border: 1.5px dashed #f5b84c; animation: ds-spin 1.1s linear infinite; } .ds-dot-down { background: #f2646b; } .ds-dot-down::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -1px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(to top right, transparent calc(50% - 1px), #12161d calc(50% - 1px), #12161d calc(50% + 1px), transparent calc(50% + 1px)); } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

components.name: Session Row
components.description: Flat, hairline-divided list row — the session list's only unit.
components.css: .ds-session-item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.7rem; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #1c212b; color: #e6e9ef; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-session-item:hover { background: #12161d; } .ds-session-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.18rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-session-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-session-subtitle { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; color: #8b95a5; }

narrative.overview: Piper reads like an SRE's dashboard shrunk onto a phone: dense, semantic, and legible in under a second, never a rounded-bubble chat-app costume. Every session is a row on a status wall, not a conversation thread in a list — color and shape together say what's happening before anyone reads a word, and one interactive accent is spent only on things you can actually press. This is a self-hosted, single-operator tool glanced at mid-task, so density and speed of comprehension outrank warmth or personality; brand lives in small, precise details rather than in an expressive surface.
keyCharacteristics: Status is read by shape and color, never color alone.
One accent color, reserved strictly for actionable meaning.
Dense monospace for identifiers; humanist sans for conversation.
Flat throughout — no fake material, glass, or gradient hierarchy.
Two-pane at desktop widths, single column on the phone.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only color allowed to mean "you can act here."

rules.name: The Status Is Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Status colors never appear on non-status UI.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Stable identifiers set in JetBrains Mono; conversation sets in Inter.

rules.name: The Three-Step Rule
rules.body: Depth is ground/raised/inset and nothing else.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono for every identifier and Inter for everything conversational.
Do encode every status with a distinct shape as well as its color.
Do keep Signal Blue exclusive to interactive/actionable meaning.
Do self-host any font or icon asset — no runtime CDN dependency.
Do draw every icon as a real stroke-based SVG from the shared sprite.
donts: Don't add a colored border-left/right above 1px to indicate selection — use a tinted fill.
Don't use gradients, glass/blur-as-decoration, or hard offset shadows.
Don't use emoji or bare Unicode glyphs as icons, anywhere, including JS-generated content.
Don't treat Inter as an unexamined slop finding on this Operate surface — it's the correct, accepted call.
Don't stretch the mobile single-column layout full-bleed at desktop widths.
